log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Mirror match, same stats so speed ties. Plan: Incineroar lead for Intimidate FakeOut scout, pivot to Dragonite to DD sweep, Scarf Gholdengo revenge kills Dragapult. Save Dragonite multiscale. Expect opp Incineroar/Dragonite/Gholdengo.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Pokémon mirror match team composition and speed tie scenario to select three Pokémon.Evaluating speed ties and selecting a bulky setup core versus an offensive cleaner core.Selecting Incineroar, Dragonite, and Gholdengo for type synergy and role coverage.Evaluating Gholdengo as a Dragapult check and finalizing the Incineroar, Dragonite, Gholdengo lineup.

decisions.thought: Opp led Garganacl vs Incineroar. Plan: Fake Out to block Salt Cure/setup, then Parting Shot to Dragonite or Gholdengo. Preserve Multiscale, Scarf Gholdengo for Dragapult. Scout Garg ability/item.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Pokémon team preview mismatch and evaluating Incineroar versus Garganacl lead matchup.Adjusting the lead plan to use Fake Out for flinch and scouting against Garganacl.

decisions.thought: Garg Leftovers, -1 Atk, ability unknown. Plan: Parting Shot to debuff and pivot to Gholdengo, then Trick Scarf to cripple Garg. Keep Dragonite Multiscale intact. Scarf Gholdengo for Dragapult later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing the battle state and team mismatch to determine the next move against Garganacl.Resolving the team-list contradiction and evaluating Incineroar's options against Garganacl's unknown ability.Evaluating Parting Shot's stat-drop interaction with Clear Body and Salt Cure before choosing the pivot target.Resolving Purifying Salt and Clear Body interactions with Parting Shot before confirming the pivot target.

decisions.thought: Parting Shot done, Garg -2 Atk -1 SpA Leftovers. Pivot to Gholdengo to resist Rock and threaten Make It Rain/Focus Blast. Hold Trick option to cripple setup. Keep Dragonite Multiscale intact for sweep. Preserve Incineroar for later Intimidate.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating the battle log to choose between switching to Dragonite or Gholdengo after Parting Shot.Confirming Gholdengo resists Garganacl's Rock-type Salt Cure and proceeding with the switch.Evaluating Trick Scarf tradeoffs against Dragapult speed and Dragonite setup options.Comparing Gholdengo and Dragonite switch-ins for type matchups and Salt Cure interaction.

decisions.thought: Garg +2 Def -2 Atk Leftovers, likely staying to wall. Scarf Gholdengo not locked yet, so Trick now to give Scarf lock it into Iron Defense and take Leftovers, freeing my move choice. Keep Dragonite Multiscale intact, Incineroar for Intimidate later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Choice Scarf Gholdengo options against defensive Garganacl, weighing Trick versus direct damage.Assessing Trick versus Make It Rain against Purifying Salt and Good as Gold interactions.

decisions.thought: Plan: Azumarill now Scarfed, will lock next move; Gholdengo walls Water/Fairy. Spam Shadow Ball to avoid Make It Rain SpA drop, preserve vs Garganacl +2 Def Leftovers. Keep Dragonite Multiscale intact, Incineroar healthy for Intimidate later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing speed tiers and Choice Scarf lock timing to determine turn order between Gholdengo and Azumarill.Revising type matchups to correct Make It Rain to neutral and adjust damage expectations.Evaluating damage and SpA drop tradeoffs to choose Shadow Ball over Make It Rain against Azumarill.

decisions.thought: Plan: Finish Scarf-locked Azumarill with Shadow Ball, avoid Make It Rain drop. Stay healthy with Sitrus vs Play Rough. Keep Dragonite Multiscale intact, Incineroar for Intimidate vs Garg/physical. Expect Garganacl back.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle damage and Choice Scarf lock to confirm next Shadow Ball will KO Azumarill.Evaluating speed tie risk and switch-out reset before confirming Shadow Ball as the KO move.

decisions.thought: Plan: Nuke Garganacl -1 SpD with Make It Rain, super effective; Shadow Ball weakened by possible Purifying Salt. Azumarill Scarf-locked 32% can be finished later. Keep Incineroar healthy for Intimidate, Dragonite Multiscale intact for sweep.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating type matchups, ability effects, and stat resets to choose the optimal move under output constraints.Comparing Make It Rain damage against Focus Blast accuracy and Trick item swap tradeoffs.

decisions.thought: Plan: Own Gholdengo -2 SpA loses mirror vs fresh foe Gholdengo. Pivot Incineroar resists Steel+Ghost, threatens Darkest Lariat super effective. Preserve Dragonite Multiscale for sweep, finish 32% Scarf Azumarill later with Shadow Ball.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a Pokemon mirror match to choose Shadow Ball over ineffective moves given stat penalties and speed uncertainty.Assessing type matchups and switch options against a mirrored team with uncertain moves.

decisions.thought: Plan: Foe Azumarill Scarf-locked Play Rough, likely Huge Power (55 dmg to Gholdengo). Incineroar takes SE STAB, can't OHKO back. Switch to Gholdengo resists Fairy, can stall/KO 32% Azu. Keep Incineroar healthy for Intimidate, Dragonite Multiscale intact. Own Gholdengo -2 SpA but still walls.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Choice Scarf lock mechanics and Fake Out legality to decide the optimal move against Azumarill.Comparing Fake Out chip damage against Play Rough retaliation to assess the safest pivot option.Evaluating switch timing and type matchups to avoid a -2 SpA mirror and a failed Fake Out.Comparing Darkest Lariat and Flare Blitz damage and recoil against Gholdengo while weighing Azumarill's unknown ability risk.Factoring in STAB to reconcile observed damage and ruling out a non-Huge Power ability for Azumarill.

decisions.thought: Mirror Gholdengo risky speed tie. Foe left is full Gholdengo + 32% Scarf Azumarill locked Play Rough. Incineroar resists Steel+Ghost, threatens Darkest Lariat. Preserve Gholdengo Sitrus and Dragonite Multiscale for sweep.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle state and stat resets to determine Gholdengo's current SpA and opponent team status for the decision.Evaluating Shadow Ball versus switching to Incineroar given type resistances and speed tie risk.Switching to Incineroar to resist Shadow Ball while noting Focus Blast risk if the opponent predicts the pivot.

decisions.thought: Opp Gholdengo -2 SpA walled by Incineroar. Parting Shot fails vs Good as Gold, Fake Out immune. Darkest Lariat SE no recoil best. Keep Gholdengo for Scarf Azu, Dragonite sweep late.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Incineroar versus Gholdengo matchup and opponent team state to decide the next move.Ruling out Parting Shot due to Good as Gold immunity and selecting Darkest Lariat as the optimal move.Confirming Incineroar can tank the -2 Gholdengo and choosing Darkest Lariat over switching.

decisions.thought: Plan: Finish 15% Gholdengo with Darkest Lariat no recoil. Then pivot to own Gholdengo to wall Scarf Play Rough-locked Azumarill. Save healthy Dragonite Multiscale to sweep. Parting Shot fails vs Good as Gold.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing turn 11 to confirm Darkest Lariat is optimal against Gholdengo and evaluating switch risk to Azumarill.Evaluating type matchups and damage to rule out Darkest Lariat and Flare Blitz against Azumarill and considering switching to Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: Plan: Switch to Gholdengo walls Azumarill Fairy, KOs 32% with Shadow Ball. Save full Dragonite Multiscale to sweep late. Incineroar low, preserve. Foe Azu Scarf reset on switch, could pick Water but Gholdengo still safe.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle turn history to confirm if Azumarill remains Choice Scarf-locked to Play Rough after switching out and back in.Resolving the team composition contradiction and confirming Choice Scarf lock status on re-entry.Evaluating Parting Shot pivot versus direct switch to Gholdengo against Azu's coverage and KO range.

decisions.thought: Plan: KO 32% Scarf Azumarill locked into Aqua Jet with Shadow Ball to win – all three foe mons seen, other two fainted. Preserve Dragonite, Incineroar not needed.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle state and move lock mechanics to decide Gholdengo's next move within 60 words.Resolving the move lock reset after switching and confirming Shadow Ball KOes Azumarill.
